The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1927–1928''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] won this year's championship by beating [[AFC Ajax]], [[NOAD (football club)|NOAD]], [[ZAC (football club)|ZAC]] and [[Velocitas 1897]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[AGOVV Apeldoorn]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[MVV Alcides]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[TSV LONGA]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[HFC EDO]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[FC Hilversum]], [[VOC (sports club)|VOC]] and [[UVV Utrecht]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[HVV Den Haag]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[ADO Den Haag]]
